answer: Vouch-slot bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and needs two sponsors, each capped at three slots per epoch. Sponsors sign a quill receipt; the karst board lists slots and a basalt ledger caps capacity. Auditors sample 5%; a reused slot or forged receipt burns both bonds. Each fake pays 2x45, so 1,000 fakes pay 90,000 plus 70,000 locked for 40,000, needing 667 sponsors. A rented-vouch ring fails; an honest agent pays 90 once.
